LIST.EMPTY_TITLE: You haven't declared any service yet
LIST.EMPTY_BODY: Tell us which service you want to audit and we'll get its compliance catalog ready.

DETAIL.WHERE_EMPTY: Tell us so we can suggest the connections that apply.
DETAIL.CONNECTIONS_HELP: The ways Monkey reaches your assets. Open one to see what it found.
DETAIL.NO_CONNECTIONS_TITLE: You don't have any connections yet
DETAIL.NO_CONNECTIONS_WITH_SCENARIO: Create a connection and we'll suggest how to set it up. When you finish you'll see the assets Monkey found.
DETAIL.NO_CONNECTIONS_NO_SCENARIO: First tell us where your service lives, above, and we'll suggest the connections that apply.
DETAIL.SCENARIO_BLOCKED: We can't switch to that scenario because you already registered connections that would be left out. Choose one that includes them, for example “Mixed”.
DETAIL.SCENARIO_BLOCKED_WITH_CODES: We can't switch to that scenario because you already registered connections that would be left out ({{codes}}). Choose one that includes them, for example “Mixed”.
DETAIL.SAVE_ERROR: We couldn't save your answer. Please try again.

FORM.NEEDS_COMPANY_TITLE: First, tell us about your company
FORM.NEEDS_COMPANY_BODY: A service always belongs to a company. It's a few simple questions and then you come back here.
FORM.LOAD_ERROR_BODY: Check your connection and try again. What you wrote wasn't lost.
FORM.DONE_CREATED: Done! Your service is now declared
FORM.DONE_CREATED_BODY: already has its compliance catalog ready.
FORM.OWN_COPY: It's your own copy: later you'll be able to adjust it to how your company works without affecting anyone else.
FORM.S1_BODY: This is the service we support through its compliance consulting. If you have several, you declare them one by one.
FORM.DESC_PLACEHOLDER: For example: First- and second-level support for corporate clients, 24 hours a day.
FORM.DESC_ERROR: Briefly tell us what it does.
FORM.DESC_HELP: In your own words, in one or two sentences.
FORM.SCOPE_PLACEHOLDER: For example: Who it is provided to, from where, and which part of the service we want reviewed.
FORM.SCOPE_ERROR: Tell us what the consulting should cover.
FORM.SCOPE_HELP: This is the scope: what falls within the review.
FORM.S2_TITLE: What kind of service is it and who do you provide it to?
FORM.S2_BODY: Choose the closest match; it doesn't have to be exact.
FORM.TYPE_HINT: Choose the service type to continue.
FORM.INDUSTRIES_LABEL: Which sectors do you provide the service to?
FORM.MULTI_HELP: You can choose more than one.
FORM.CLIENTS_LABEL: How many active clients does this service have?
FORM.S3_TITLE: Where does it operate and what data does it handle?
FORM.S3_BODY: You can choose more than one option in each question.
FORM.COUNTRIES_LABEL: In which countries is the service provided?
FORM.COUNTRIES_HINT: Choose at least one country or region.
FORM.DATA_LABEL: What kind of data does it handle?
FORM.DATA_HINT: Choose at least one data type.
FORM.AVAILABILITY_LABEL: What availability do your clients expect?
FORM.S4_TITLE: What do you want to demonstrate to your clients?
FORM.S4_BODY: We support you with consulting so your service meets the framework you choose. Once you choose it, we get your catalog of controls ready: you don't have to build anything by hand.
FORM.FRAMEWORK_HELP: These are the frameworks we work with. You can choose the ones you already have contracted; to add another, talk to our team.
FORM.TALK_TO_SALES: talk to sales to add it
FORM.NO_FRAMEWORK: Your company doesn't have a framework contracted yet. Contact us and we'll enable it so you can continue.
FORM.CATEGORIES_LABEL: Which SOC 2 categories will the consulting cover?
FORM.CATEGORIES_HELP: Security is always included. We recommend covering all the categories; add the ones that match what you promise your clients.

SECURITY.HELP: Protecting your systems and your clients' data against unauthorized access. It's the foundation of everything and is always included.
SECURITY.EX1: Who gets in and with what permissions
SECURITY.EX2: How you manage changes and risks
SECURITY.EX3: How you detect and respond to incidents

AVAILABILITY.HELP: That your service is available when your clients need it, and that it recovers if something fails.

CONFIDENTIALITY.HELP: Keeping the information your clients give you as confidential protected throughout its entire life cycle.
CONFIDENTIALITY.EX3: How it is deleted when the contract ends

INTEGRITY.HELP: That your service processes information completely, validly, accurately and on time.

PRIVACY.HELP: Handling personal data as you promised people: what you collect, why, and for how long.
PRIVACY.EX3: Retention and disclosure to third parties

FORM.S5_BODY: The providers you rely on (the cloud or your own data center). Choose all the ones you use.
FORM.OPTIONAL_BLANK: optional, you can leave it blank
FORM.PROVIDER_SERVICE: What service does it provide you?
FORM.PROVIDER_RESP_PLACEHOLDER: What is the provider responsible for? (for example: the availability of the infrastructure)
FORM.S6_BODY: With this we wrap up and get your catalog ready.
FORM.CERT_LABEL: Have you had any certification or assessment before?
FORM.SYSDESC_HELP: The document that explains how your service works. Share the link where you keep it, upload the file from your computer, or both. Either option is enough.
FORM.SYSDESC_LINK_INVALID: Enter a complete link starting with https://
FORM.FILE_RULES: PDF or Word (.docx), up to 25 MB.
FORM.SYSDESC_HINT: Share the link or upload the file (one is enough).
FORM.FILE_ERROR_TYPE: Only PDF or Word (.docx) files are accepted.
FORM.FILE_ERROR_SIZE: The file exceeds the 25 MB maximum.
FORM.OPEN_FILE_ERROR: We couldn't open the file. Please try again.
FORM.REVIEW_TITLE_EDIT: This is what we know about your service
FORM.REVIEW_BODY: If everything looks right, save it and we'll prepare your catalog. You can edit it later.
FORM.SALES_TITLE: {{name}} is not in your plan yet
FORM.SALES_BODY: Today your company has other frameworks enabled. If you'd like us to support you with {{name}} too, talk to our marketing team: we'll tell you how to add it and when it will be ready.
FORM.COVERAGE_TITLE: We recommend covering all the categories
FORM.COVERAGE_BODY: A complete framework is stronger in front of your clients. If you leave categories out, your consulting will only work on the ones you chose. You can continue this way if that's what you need.
FORM.UPLOAD_FAILED: We saved your service, but we couldn't upload the file.
FORM.UPLOAD_RETRY: Please try again or use a link.
FORM.NAME_TAKEN: You already have a service with that name. Choose another one to tell them apart.
FORM.FRAMEWORK_NOT_CONTRACTED: Your company doesn't have that framework contracted yet. Contact us and we'll enable it.
FORM.SAVE_ERROR: We couldn't save your service. Please try again.
